title: Eiichiro Oda’s ‘ONE PIECE’ Vol. 115 Rises to No. 1 on Japan Book Hot 100
summary: Last week’s No. 1 debut, Yoshihiro Togashi's HUNTER×HUNTER Vol. 39, follows at No. 2 by a slim margin.
contentText:
Eiichiro Oda’s ONE PIECE Vol. 115 climbs 2-1 on the Billboard Japan Book Hot 100, on the chart released Jul. 16.

The title again leads in brick-and-mortar while adding points in e-commerce (EC) and social media to claim the overall top spot. The digital edition is due out Aug. 4.

Last week’s No. 1 debut, Yoshihiro Togashi’s HUNTER×HUNTER Vol. 39, follows at No. 2 by a slim margin. The title continues to top e-books for a second week while also holding at No. 2 for brick-and-mortar and No. 5 for EC. Haruki Murakami’s The Tale of KAHO , which debuted at No. 3 last week, slips to No. 4 but continues to dominate social media. The three titles behind last week’s intense chart competition all hold their ground in the upper tier.

Breaking into that upper tier is Bullet Train’s Takashi with his debut photobook, BULLET TRAIN TAKASHI 1st Photobook “xemx,” which bows at No. 3 after topping EC. Hiromu Arakawa’s Yomi no Tsugai ( Daemons of the Shadow Realm ) Vol. 13 — currently airing as an anime series — also launches at No. 5, landing in the top 20 across brick-and-mortar, EC and e-books.

Ryunosuke Matsushita’s Ichijigen no Sashiki ( Labyrinth of Hortensia and the Minotaur ) jumps from No. 27 to No. 13, following the Jul. 5 premiere of the live-action drama adaptation starring Ryosuke Yamada. The title hits No. 3 on social media and improves its ranking across all five metrics week-over-week.

The Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 is a comprehensive chart combining physical sales, e-books, library loans, subscription data and social media activity. Below are the top 10 titles on this week’s list, tracking the period from July 6 to 12.

(Numbers in parentheses indicate the title’s metric placements for brick-and-mortar, EC, e-books, subscriptions, and social media, top 20 only. English title given if translations or adaptations exist.)
